answer: Orchard-Claim Decay Curve: each identity claim opens a decaying claim balance that grants throughput proportional to its age, seeded small and replenished only by settled trades. Fresh claims enter a shallow ocean of near-zero capacity, so an attacker must fund and run every account through weeks of real settlement to reach useful volume. Marginal cost per sybil rises with fleet size since each claim needs its own history; willow-thin returns make the campaign unprofitable.
